title: Diane Powell's inbox full of parents saying their children read their thoughts

tellings.quote: email box was filled of parents reaching out saying saying I'm finding that my child can read my thoughts

plain: Around 2022 and 2023, the email inbox of a researcher named Diane Powell filled with messages from parents, all saying something like "I'm finding that my child can read my thoughts." The documentary maker Ky Dickens, who made a film called The Telepathy Tapes, says she saw this firsthand. She tells it as a sign that many families were seeing the same thing, which, if true, would point to children with telepathy, meaning the ability to read minds.
